zh.title: 地址看起来相同，签发者身份就相同吗？
zh.summary: 三组有效地址在签发者辅助函数下相等，在严格字符串比较下不等。隔离探针揭示比较合同的差异，并为真实回调路径留下明确的待验证问题。

en.title: When similar issuer URLs are different identities
en.summary: Three valid HTTPS pairs compare equal under an issuer helper but unequal under strict string comparison. Isolated probes expose an equality-contract difference while leaving the real callback path untested.
